description: Cross-superposition of DSF2 repeat segments onto Sel1-repeat, TPR, and control structures
code:
exec(open("work/lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def ca_of(pdb, chain, lo=None, hi=None):
    res,order=parse_pdb(f"work/{pdb}.pdb", chain=chain)
    o=[r for r in order if (lo is None or r[1]>=lo) and (hi is None or r[1]<=hi)]
    return np.array([res[r]['atoms']['CA'] for r in o]), np.array([r[1] for r in o]), "".join(res[r]['aa'] for r in o)

CAd,nd,sd = ca_of("AF-P38213","A",548,731)
libs = {
 "HcpC 1OUV (Sel1-like)":   ca_of("1OUV","A")[0],
 "HcpB 1KLX (Sel1-like)":   ca_of("1KLX","A")[0],
 "Hrd3 6VJZ (Sel1L-like)":  ca_of("6VJZ","A",26,686)[0],
 "Hop TPR2A 1ELR (TPR)":    ca_of("1ELR","A")[0],
 "Hop TPR1 1ELW (TPR)":     ca_of("1ELW","A")[0],
 "PP5 TPR 1A17 (TPR)":      ca_of("1A17","A",19,140)[0],
 "Myoglobin 1MBN (ctrl)":   ca_of("1MBN","A")[0],
 "ROP 1ROP (ctrl)":         ca_of("1ROP","A")[0],
}
def best_gapless(probe, target):
    L=len(probe); best=(99,None)
    for i in range(0,len(target)-L+1):
        r=rmsd_after(probe, target[i:i+L])
        if r<best[0]: best=(r,i)
    return best

probes = {
 "1 repeat unit (643-680, 38aa)": (643,680),
 "2 repeat units (643-717, 75aa)": (643,717),
 "2 repeat units (563-634, 72aa)": (563,634),
 "3 repeat units (643-731, 89aa)": (643,731),
}
rows=[]
for pname,(a,b) in probes.items():
    sel=(nd>=a)&(nd<=b); probe=CAd[sel]
    line={"probe":pname,"len":int(sel.sum())}
    for lname,T in libs.items():
        if len(T)<len(probe): line[lname]=np.nan; continue
        r,i=best_gapless(probe,T); line[lname]=round(r,2)
    rows.append(line)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("probe")
pd.set_option("display.width",220)
print("Best gapless CA-RMSD (A) of DSF2 probe segments onto reference structures\n")
print(df.to_string())
df.to_csv("work/cross_superposition.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.6))
sub=df.drop(columns=["len"])
cols=list(sub.columns); x=np.arange(len(cols)); wdt=0.2
colors=["#1f4e79","#2a9d8f","#e76f51","#6a4c93"]
for k,(idx,row) in enumerate(sub.iterrows()):
    ax.bar(x+(k-1.5)*wdt, row.values.astype(float), wdt, label=idx, color=colors[k%4])
ax.axhline(4.0, ls="--", color="grey", lw=1); ax.text(len(cols)-0.6,4.1,"4 A",color="grey",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([c.replace(" (","\n(") for c in cols], fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("best gapless CA RMSD (A)")
ax.set_title("DSF2 548-731 repeat segments superpose on Sel1-like repeat proteins, not on TPR or non-repeat controls")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
